covenants.quote: shall not, at any time during the period from 2024-01-01 to 2024-12-31 when its Net Leverage Ratio exceeds 3.25x, sell, transfer, contribute or otherwise dispose of any asset constituting Collateral to any Unrestricted Subsidiary where the aggregate value of all such transfers exceeds $500,000.00
covenants.formula_description: Springing limitation: aggregate value of transfers of Collateral assets to Unrestricted Subsidiaries, applicable only when Net Leverage Ratio exceeds 3.25x

carve_outs.quote: a transfer to a Restricted Subsidiary shall not be counted

covenants.quote: shall not permit its Net Leverage Ratio to exceed 3.00x as measured over the period from 2024-01-01 to 2024-12-31
covenants.formula_description: Net Leverage Ratio = Net Debt / EBITDA, where Net Debt = Financial Indebtedness drawn during the period less scheduled principal repayments made in that period, and EBITDA = Revenue less Operating Expenses

covenants.quote: shall not permit Revenue recognised in any single fiscal quarter falling within the period from 2024-01-01 to 2024-12-31 to exceed 0.30x, expressed as a multiple of Revenue for that period taken as a whole
covenants.formula_description: Ratio of Revenue recognised in any single fiscal quarter to total Revenue for the full covenant period
